description: RCS demo: airliner (20 dBsm) vs stealth drone (-10 dBsm) at ~100km where 30dB RCS gap produces clear Pd differential. Both fly parallel crossing paths.
_NOTE: At 100km with PSR ref range 111km and refRCS 0dBsm: airliner (100m2) has SNR factor ~120x -> Pd~1.0. Stealth (0.1m2) has SNR factor ~0.12x -> Pd~0.1-0.3. Should produce >2x detection ratio.
